faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is integrative medicine and how does it differ from conventional medicine?
faq.a1: Integrative medicine blends evidence-based conventional protocols with a holistic perspective, identifying and resolving root causes across all body systems.
faq.q2: How should I prepare for an initial endocrinologist appointment?
faq.a2: Bring prior lab tests from the past 6 months and a complete list of current medications and supplements.
faq.q3: Can a doctor visit me at home urgently?
faq.a3: Yes, our mobile emergency physician team operates daily throughout Kazan and surrounding areas with portable diagnostic gear.
faq.q4: Do you provide tax deduction documentation (13%)?
faq.a4: Yes, we prepare all official certificates and payment statements required for tax refunds in full.
